rules.sentence: Post-appendectomy stump appendicitis most commonly occurs in cases of perforated appendicitis.
Stump appendicitis, a form of recurrent appendicitis, may occur when an inadequate amount of appendiceal tissue is resected, and a long stump is left behind.[59]
Resection of adequate appendiceal tissue with less than 5 mm of stump preservation is recommended to minimize risk.[60]
